title: 680. Image Smoother

examples.explanation: Each corner averages 3 neighbours, each edge 6, and the center 9; all floors are 0.
Averages include the cell plus every valid neighbour, rounded down.

hints: Compute every output cell from the original grid, not from partly smoothed values.
Loop over the 3x3 window offsets (-1..1) and keep only in-bounds neighbours.
Integer division already floors the average.
